The whole programme once built: a labelled issue becomes sandboxed agent runs, each under its own identity, collaborating in a room. The agent is not trusted: every control sits outside the sandbox.
The stroke of each box says how far it has got (legend, bottom left). The same manifests deploy to gcp-0 and aws-0.
